tags.name: DBS Assembly Orders
tags.description:
To access the methods, use a token for the Marketplace category
**How to work:** 1. [Get the new order](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1new/get) and save it until it is ready for assembly. If you do not save the order information in advance, you will only be able to access it after the order is completed (either canceled or sold). Check the [delivery date and time](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1delivery-date/post). 2. [Transfer it for assembly](./orders-dbs?locale=ru#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1confirm/post). 3. [Transfer to delivery](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1deliver/post). 4. After the order is transferred to assembly, [buyer information](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1client/post) (name, phone) becomes available. 5. After delivering the task to the buyer, you need to notify our server that the [order was accepted](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1receive/post) by the buyer or that the [buyer declined the order](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1reject/post).

Описание метода
Returns the statuses of [assembly orders](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders) based on the list of assembly order IDs. `supplierStatus` is a status of an order. The trigger for its change is the action of the seller himself.
Possible values for this field are: | Status | Description | How to move an order to this status | | ------- | --------- | --------------------------------------| | `new` | **New order** | | | `confirm` | **Order on assembly** | [Transfer to assembly](./orders-dbs?locale=ru#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1confirm/post) | `deliver` | **Order on delivery**
| [Transfer to delivery](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1deliver/post) | `receive` | **Received by the buyer**
| [Notify that the order has been accepted by the buyer](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1receive/post)
| `reject` | **Declined upon receipt**
| [Notify that the buyer has declined the order](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1reject/post) | `cancel` | **Canceled by the supplier** | [Cancel the order](./orders-dbs#tag/DBS-Assembly-Orders/paths/~1api~1marketplace~1v3~1dbs~1orders~1status~1cancel/post) | `cancel_missed_call` | **Cancellation due to unreachable buyer**
| The status changes automatically | `wbStatus` is a status of an order on the Wildberries side.
Possible values for this field are: - `waiting` — assembly order in work - `sold` — the buyer got the order - `canceled` — assembly order canceled - `canceled_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order - `declined_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order in the first hour
Cancellation is available to the buyer in the first hour from the moment of order, if the order is not transferred to confirm status. - `defect` — order canceled due to a defect - `ready_for_pickup` — the order arrived the pickup point - `canceled_by_missed_call`— cancellation due to unreachable buyer. For delivery by supplier
Request limit per one seller's account for DBS assembly orders methods: | Period | Limit | Interval | Burst | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 min | 300 requests | 200 ms | 20 requests |

Описание метода
Sets the labeling code [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en) for the assembly orders.

For more information about labeling code Chestny ZNAK please check: https://chestnyznak.ru/en/.

decision.description:
State:
- `imei`
  - `pending` — Metadata for inspection
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
  - `filled` — Validation passed
  - `deadlineExceeded` — Validation passed
  - `imeiMaySell` — The product is approved for sale. Validation passed
  - `imeiSoldB2B` — The product was sold to a B2B buyer and allowed to be sold again. Validation passed
  - `required` — Required metadata is not filled. Validation failed
  - `imeiInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed
  - `imeiAlreadySold` — The item with this IMEI has already been sold. Validation failed
- `uin`
  - `filled` — Validation passed
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
- `sgtin`
  - `pending` — Metadata for inspection
  - `optional` — Metadata is not required
  - `filled` — Validation passed
  - `deadlineExceeded` — Validation passed
  - `sgtinIntroduced` — The product is approved for sale. Validation passed
  - `sgtinSoldB2B` — The product was sold to a B2B buyer and allowed to be sold again. Validation passed
  - `required` — Required metadata is not filled. Validation failed
  - `sgtinInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed
  - `sgtinNotFound` — Metadata not found in [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en/). Validation failed
  - `sgtinEmitted` —  Metadata has been issued. Validation failed
